problem.input: n by n structured Quad4 element grid

metric.name: driver_reported_synchronized_max_rank_solve_wall_seconds
metric.grain: one fixed-size coupled solve per rank count and repeat
metric.timed_region: from a synchronized pre-Newton barrier through a synchronized final barrier; maximum elapsed MPI wall time across ranks
metric.aggregation: median with every sample and minimum/maximum retained
metric.rank_aggregation: maximum synchronized MPI wall time across ranks

linear.preconditioner: additive fieldsplit with GAMG per scalar field

protocol.warmup_policy: no discarded warm-ups; every fresh launch is retained and aggregated
protocol.kernel_protocol: fresh per-rank generated-kernel build before the synchronized timed region of every launch
protocol.launcher_scope: single launcher-visible host; no hostfile arguments
protocol.optional_processor_list: --cpu-list <processor IDs>; the harness records the exact list and generates a retained Open MPI rankfile with one selected processor per rank
